entries.triggerSummary: Add a new REST endpoint to an existing service, including route handler, input validation, and a test that exercises the success path.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Define the route shape: method, path, request body, response body, status codes
Add the route handler and wire it to the existing router
dependsOn: Define the route shape: method, path, request body, response body, status codes

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add input validation (zod or equivalent) and return 400 on validation error
dependsOn: Add the route handler and wire it to the existing router

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add a test that exercises the success path and one validation failure
dependsOn: Add input validation (zod or equivalent) and return 400 on validation error

entries.triggerSummary: Add a new background job that consumes a queue / cron schedule and performs idempotent work.

subGoalSkeleton.description: Decide trigger source: cron expression OR queue subscription
Implement the job handler with idempotency: same input → same outcome
dependsOn: Decide trigger source: cron expression OR queue subscription

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add metrics + structured logs around the handler
dependsOn: Implement the job handler with idempotency: same input → same outcome

subGoalSkeleton.description: Add a test that runs the handler with a fixture input and asserts the side effect
dependsOn: Implement the job handler with idempotency: same input → same outcome
